build_multimodal_net: build a multimodal neural network with task-specific input layers and shared hidden layers
create_net_forward: create a forward pass through the Net model with input tensor and task index
train_net_observe: train the Net model on a single observation using forward loss backward and optimizer step
reset_bias_function: reset the bias of a PyTorch module to zero using the reset_bias utility function
review_net_init: review the Net class initialization with configurable n_layers n_hiddens and SGD optimizer
